verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a media relay product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a managed service: relays are created and managed through the Cloudflare dashboard and API. Nothing documents a self-hostable relay. The moq-interop-runner reference is a third-party testing tool, not a way to self-host Cloudflare's relay.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
